text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp begins today.
At the academy's special facility,
it's time to buckle down and train!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ! You got it, Vivlos! Just make sure you catch it properly, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Crowwn~!
This ball is way too heavy~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That thing Miss Crown has is a medicine ball.
It's used to build power and core strength.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! That wasn't a beach ball~?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Plus, it's custom-made, so I cranked up the weight~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wait alone in front of the room
filled with the lively voices of the girls.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once Satono Crown is ready,
we'll begin training for the summer training camp.
